creator_outward_copy.deletion_behavior: managed Vault deletion does not claim to erase an independently retained creator copy
creator_outward_copy.recovery_behavior: a later explicit import is a new deliberate lifecycle action, not silent recovery

managed_recovery.authority: product-managed recovery copy or restore staging state
managed_recovery.deletion_behavior: not ordinary source authority and cannot silently revive deleted managed Vault state
managed_recovery.recovery_behavior: restore must reconcile current deletion barriers before restored material becomes active
managed_recovery.retention_rule: bounded recovery cohort; current maximum is 30 days where no shorter state-bound rule applies

operational.authority: state/event-bound runtime, acquisition, security, or coordination state
operational.deletion_behavior: purged or invalidated when its governing lifecycle ends or deletion makes it stale
operational.recovery_behavior: may support restart/retry but cannot override current deletion barriers
operational.retention_rule: bounded by the operational event/state; archive enablement does not make it indefinite

vault.deletion_behavior: creator deletion uses durable deletion barriers and removes managed source/dependent state
vault.recovery_behavior: restore and replay must reconcile current deletion barriers before publication
vault.retention_rule: bounded working retention unless an explicit Creator Vault policy applies

workspace.authority: non-authoritative analytics/read-model state derived from canonical source state
workspace.deletion_behavior: source-scope deletion invalidates or rebuilds dependent state
workspace.recovery_behavior: may be discarded/rebuilt; restored copies remain subordinate to canonical deletion authority
workspace.retention_rule: bounded or disposable; participant-linked analytics remain bounded and no hidden raw archive is permitted
